name: Freeman-Sheldon症候群

summary.text: A rare congenital, distal arthogryposis syndrome characterized by microstomia, whistling-face appearance, Chin with V- or H- shaped creased, and prominent nasolabial folds; most patients present club foot and congenital joint contractures of the hands and feet. It is the most severe form of distal arthrogryposis.

symptoms.text: congenital joint contractures of the hands and feet
